mapper.select: SELECT ub2.userId, COUNT(*) as commonItems, SUM(ub1.behaviorValue * ub2.behaviorValue) as similarity FROM user_behavior ub1 INNER JOIN user_behavior ub2 ON ub1.itemId = ub2.itemId AND ub1.itemType = ub2.itemType AND ub1.userId != ub2.userId WHERE ub1.userId = #{userId} AND ub1.itemType = #{itemType} AND ub1.isDelete = 0 AND ub2.isDelete = 0 GROUP BY ub2.userId HAVING commonItems >= 2 ORDER BY similarity DESC LIMIT #{limit}
